kind: research-informed ban list for existing UI and branding owners
decision: Owner request: ban overused generated-interface and generated-brand defaults within reason. Reverses the 2026-10-02 rule that familiar fonts and effects are never forbidden; exceptions keep existing brands, owner selections and listed functional uses. No new discoverable skill.
